subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers split this so explicit `heartbeat.session` precedence is fixed first while Telegram DM default isolation remains a separate compatibility decision?
rationale: Source inspection supports the heartbeat precedence bug, but changing Telegram DMs away from the documented main-session default could alter existing user workflows.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeat session resolution and event migration without changing Telegram DM default routing.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default too, accepting the compatibility and docs impact in the same effort.

options.title: Defer to native heartbeat entries
options.body: Wait for the broader per-session heartbeat scheduling design, which may be cleaner but leaves the current precedence bug unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Fix event-triggered heartbeat session resolution and event migration without changing Telegram DM default routing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent heartbeat/session routing work and compatibility-sensitive decisions make this the best available owner signal from the history reviewed.
